extension.displayName: Probato PR — Code Review with Proof
extension.description: Your AI reviews the code. We verify what could break. Local, evidence-backed review of Git changes and pull requests: deterministic analyzers, approved project checks with base-vs-head regression attribution, SARIF and Markdown reports. No account or AI key required.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Reviews run Git and, with your approval, project tools. Both are disabled in Restricted Mode.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Requires a local Git repository and local process execution.
welcome.overview:
Review → Verify → Share. Find what your change could break, prove it with your own project checks, then share the evidence. No account or AI key needed.
[Review Current Changes](command:probatoPR.reviewCurrentChanges)
[Review Branch](command:probatoPR.reviewBranch)
Also: [staged changes](command:probatoPR.reviewStagedChanges), [a commit](command:probatoPR.reviewCommit) or [a GitHub pull request](command:probatoPR.reviewPullRequest). New here? [Open the walkthrough](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%5B%22armotusitio.probato-pr%23getStarted%22%2Cfalse%5D).
welcome.untrusted:
Probato PR runs Git and project tools, so it is disabled in Restricted Mode.
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)
welcome.noFolder:
Open a folder that is a Git repository to start reviewing.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
config.review.baseBranch: Branch or ref used by **Review Branch**. Empty: detect from `origin/HEAD`, then `main`/`master`.
config.review.maxFiles: Maximum number of changed files analyzed per review; the rest are listed as skipped.
config.review.maxDiffBytes: Maximum size of the diff read from Git, in bytes.
config.review.exclude: Glob patterns of changed files that are not analyzed (reported as skipped).
config.verification.timeoutSeconds: Maximum duration of each verification command before it is stopped.
config.verification.maxOutputBytes: Maximum command output kept in memory per run (the end of the output is kept).
config.verification.baseline: Whether failing checks are re-run on the base revision to attribute failures to the change.
config.verification.baseline.always: Always run the baseline for failing checks.
config.ai.provider: Optional AI reviewer. Use **Probato PR: Connect Your AI** to set it up. Code is only sent after you confirm the exact files each time.
config.ai.provider.none: No AI (default). Deterministic analysis and verification only.
config.ai.provider.vscodeLm: A chat model already available in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot).
config.ai.provider.anthropic: Anthropic Claude with your own API key (stored in SecretStorage).
config.ai.anthropicModel: Anthropic model ID used for AI review.
config.ai.maxContextChars: Maximum characters of diff sent to the AI provider per review.
config.ai.exclude: Additional glob patterns never sent to AI providers (sensitive files are always excluded).
command.openMarkdownReport: Open Markdown Report (for the PR Description)
welcome.findings.noReview:
Findings appear here after a review, grouped by severity or by file.
[Review Current Changes](command:probatoPR.reviewCurrentChanges)
welcome.findings.none:
No findings in this review. Run your project's checks to back that up with evidence.
[Verify (Run Checks)](command:probatoPR.verify)
welcome.verification.noReview: Verification runs your own checks (typecheck, lint, tests, build) and compares failures with the base revision, so you know what this change broke. Run a review first.
walkthrough.title: Get started with Probato PR
walkthrough.description: Review your changes, prove what could break, and share the evidence in three steps.
walkthrough.review.title: 1. Review your changes
walkthrough.review.description:
Probato PR analyzes your Git changes locally: removed exports with broken consumers, weakened tests, leaked secrets, risky config and more. Nothing leaves your machine.
[Review Current Changes](command:probatoPR.reviewCurrentChanges)
walkthrough.verify.title: 2. Verify with evidence
walkthrough.verify.description:
Run the checks your project already has. If one fails, Probato PR re-runs it on the base revision to tell new failures from existing ones. You approve every command first.
[Verify Findings](command:probatoPR.verify)
walkthrough.share.title: 3. Share the result
walkthrough.share.description:
Export SARIF for code scanning, JSON with the full evidence, or Markdown to paste into your pull request description.
[Export Report](command:probatoPR.exportReport)
walkthrough.ai.title: Optional: add an AI reviewer
walkthrough.ai.description:
Use a chat model you already have in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot), or your own Claude, OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible key (OpenRouter, Ollama…). The AI adds a second opinion and writes the pull request summary. You confirm the exact files before anything is sent, and AI findings stay suspected until a check proves them.
[Connect Your AI](command:probatoPR.connectAi)
config.ai.provider.openaiCompatible: OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio) with your own key.
config.ai.vscodeLmModel: Chat model used with the VS Code provider, as vendor/id. Empty: the first available model.
config.ai.openaiCompatible.baseUrl: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (ends before `/chat/completions`). HTTPS is required except for servers on this machine. User-level setting only: a workspace cannot redirect your API key.
config.ai.openaiCompatible.model: Model ID for the OpenAI-compatible API. Pick it from the provider's list with **Connect Your AI**.
config.ai.includeFileContent: Also send the full current content of changed files (after the diffs, within maxContextChars) so the AI understands the surrounding code. The confirmation dialog lists these files.
